videos.topic: Somaliland's contested independence and legal paradox based on unratified union.
The double betrayal of Chagos Islanders, UK/Mauritius roles, and strategic geopolitics.
Debunking the 19th-century myth that medieval Europeans believed in a flat Earth.
Iran's 200-year cycle of constitutional demands, foreign intervention, and popular protests.
The Belavezha Accords, dissolution of the USSR, and modern geopolitical implications.
The phantom Bermeja Island: a cartographic error, oil stakes, and conspiracy theories.
Operation Condor: transnational repression, US involvement, and ongoing legal accountability.
Gibraltar: Treaty of Utrecht, sovereignty disputes, referendums, and Brexit implications.
Vichy France's anti-Jewish laws: a French initiative, not German imposed or requested.
The Berlin Conference: drawing Africa's colonial borders and its lasting impact on conflict.
The Treaty of Tordesillas: splitting the world and its measurable impact on modern inequality.
India-Pakistan Partition: how Britain drew the border in 5 weeks and its human cost.

Spanish Inquisition torture rules: procedures, statistics, and debunking the Black Legend.

entities.label: Somaliland

entities.label: Somalia

entities.label: British Somaliland

entities.label: Italian Somaliland
entities.role: Colonial entity that merged with British Somaliland to form Somalia.

entities.label: Act of Union (1960)
entities.role: Legal instrument intended to merge British and Italian Somaliland, but never properly ratified.

entities.label: Uti Possidetis Principle
entities.role: International legal principle of respecting colonial borders at independence.

entities.label: Ethiopia

entities.label: Israel

entities.label: African Union (AU)

entities.label: Secession

entities.label: Restorative Secession

entities.label: Chagos Archipelago

entities.label: Diego Garcia

entities.label: United Kingdom (UK)

entities.label: Mauritius

entities.label: Middle Ages

entities.label: Conflict Thesis

entities.label: Sacrobosco's De Sphaera Mundi
entities.role: Standard university astronomy textbook in medieval Europe, teaching spherical Earth.

entities.label: Treaty of Utrecht (1713)

entities.label: Schengen Area

entities.label: Brexit

entities.label: Vichy France

entities.label: Statut des Juifs
entities.role: Anti-Jewish laws issued by Vichy France, without German demand, with Pétain's personal edits.

entities.label: Holocaust

entities.label: Philippe Pétain
entities.role: Head of Vichy France, personally annotated the Statut des Juifs to make it harsher.

entities.label: Berlin Conference (1884)
entities.role: International conference that regulated European colonization and trade in Africa.

entities.label: Africa
entities.role: Continent partitioned by European powers at the Berlin Conference, leading to lasting conflicts.

entities.label: Congo Free State
entities.role: Personal property of Leopold II, known for rubber terror and atrocities.

entities.label: Leopold II
entities.role: King of Belgium and personal owner of the Congo Free State, responsible for atrocities.

entities.label: Effective Occupation
entities.role: Principle established at Berlin Conference requiring powers to demonstrate authority in claimed coastal regions.

entities.label: Rubber Terror
entities.role: Period of extreme exploitation and atrocities in the Congo Free State under Leopold II's rule.

entities.label: Ethnic Partitioning
entities.role: Division of ethnic groups across colonial borders, leading to increased conflict.

entities.label: Rwanda
entities.role: Nation whose ethnic distinctions were manipulated by colonial powers, contributing to later genocide.

entities.label: Treaty of Tordesillas (1494)
entities.role: Treaty dividing the newly discovered non-Christian world between Spain and Portugal.

entities.label: Doctrine of Discovery
entities.role: Legal and theological framework used to justify European colonization of non-Christian lands.

entities.label: Pope Alexander VI
entities.role: Spanish Pope who issued Inter Caetera, drawing the initial line of demarcation.

entities.label: Brazil
entities.role: Nation whose Portuguese language and inequality are linked to the Treaty of Tordesillas.

entities.label: Portugal
entities.role: European power that gained eastern South America and African trade monopoly through papal bulls and treaties.

entities.label: Inter Caetera
entities.role: Papal bull issued by Pope Alexander VI, drawing the initial line of demarcation in 1493.

entities.label: Romanus Pontifex

entities.label: Dum Diversas

entities.label: Treaty of Zaragoza (1529)

entities.label: Johnson v. M'Intosh (1823)

entities.label: Yanomami Crisis

entities.label: Marco Temporal

entities.label: Requerimiento

entities.label: India-Pakistan Partition

entities.label: Cyril Radcliffe
entities.role: British lawyer who chaired the Boundary Commissions, drawing the borders for India and Pakistan in 5 weeks.

entities.label: Mountbatten

entities.label: Kashmir
entities.role: Disputed territory between India and Pakistan, its access linked to Radcliffe's border decisions.

entities.label: Punjab Boundary Commission

entities.label: Ferozepore District

entities.label: Gurdaspur District

entities.label: Manhattan Purchase Myth

entities.label: Lenape

entities.label: Dutch West India Company (WIC)

entities.label: Schagen Letter (1626)

entities.label: Usufruct

entities.label: Battle of Thermopylae
entities.role: Ancient battle between Greek city-states and the Persian Empire, subject of multiple conflicting historical accounts.

entities.label: Herodotus's The Histories
entities.role: Earliest surviving account of the Battle of Thermopylae, based on oral testimony.

entities.label: Diodorus Siculus's Library of History
entities.role: Later account of Thermopylae, drawing on the lost historian Ephorus, with moral didacticism.

entities.label: Ctesias's History of Persia

entities.label: Leonidas I

entities.label: Xerxes I
entities.role: King of the Achaemenid Empire who led the Persian invasion of Greece.

entities.label: Molon Labe
entities.role: Famous quote attributed to Leonidas, but first appears in Plutarch, 600 years later.

entities.label: Thespians
entities.role: Greek soldiers who died alongside the Spartans at Thermopylae, often overlooked.

entities.label: Treaty of Tripoli (1797)

entities.label: John Adams

entities.label: US Senate

entities.label: William Cobbett
